description_en: Updates the connection, authentication, or display information of an existing data source
description_zh: 更新已有数据源的连接、认证或展示信息
name: UpdateAgenticDataSource

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the data source to be updated
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的数据源 UUID
parameters.name: data_source_uuid

parameters.help_en: The new cloud resource instance ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 新的云资源实例 ID；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: instance_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The new display name of the data source. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 新的数据源显示名称；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: alias

parameters.help_en: The new name of the metadata catalog. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. It must start with a Chinese character, a letter, or an underscore, and can contain digits and hyphens. It cannot contain only digits
parameters.help_zh: 新的元数据目录名称；不传表示不更新。最长 128 个字符，以中文、字母或下划线开头，后续可包含数字和连字符，不能为纯数字
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: Modifying the data source type is not supported. Do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 当前不支持修改数据源类型，请勿传入
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: Optional. The new domain name or IP address of the database. Do not include the protocol, path, or port. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。新的数据库域名或 IP，不包含协议、路径和端口；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: Optional. The new service port of the database. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。新的数据库服务端口；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: Optional. For ADB_POSTGRESQL, DRDS, POSTGRESQL, and POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, specify the database name. For ORACLE, specify the SID or service name, and prefix the service name with a forward slash (/). For POLARDB_ORACLE, specify the SID. For MAXCOMPUTE, specify the project name. For other types, leave this parameter empty. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。ADB_POSTGRESQL、DRDS、POSTGRESQL、POLARDB_POSTGRESQL 填数据库名；ORACLE 填 SID 或服务名，服务名前加 /；POLARDB_ORACLE 填 SID；MAXCOMPUTE 填 Project；其他类型不填。不传表示不更新
parameters.name: schema

parameters.help_en: The name of the Snowflake compute warehouse. This parameter takes effect only when DbType is set to SNOWFLAKE
parameters.help_zh: Snowflake 计算仓库名称，仅 DbType=SNOWFLAKE 生效
parameters.name: snowflake_warehouse

parameters.help_en: The name of the Snowflake role. This parameter takes effect only when DbType is set to SNOWFLAKE
parameters.help_zh: Snowflake 角色名称，仅 DbType=SNOWFLAKE 生效
parameters.name: snowflake_role

parameters.help_en: The name of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Spark resource group. This parameter takes effect only when DbType is set to ADB_MYSQL_SPARK. If you do not specify this parameter, the original resource group is retained. This parameter is independent of Schema (database name) and they cannot be used interchangeably
parameters.help_zh: ADB MySQL Spark 资源组名称，仅 DbType=ADB_MYSQL_SPARK 生效。不传时保留原资源组；与 Schema（数据库名）独立，不能相互替代
parameters.name: adb_spark_resource_group

parameters.help_en:
Optional. The authentication type. Valid values:
-1: No authentication required.
0: Username and password.
1: Password only.
2: Password-free.
If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。取值：-1-无需认证，0-用户名和密码，1-仅密码，2-免密；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: auth_type

parameters.help_en: The new logon username. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 新的登录用户名；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: auth_account

parameters.help_en: The new logon password. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated. This is sensitive information. Do not record or disclose it
parameters.help_zh: 新的登录密码；不传表示不更新。属于敏感信息，请勿记录或泄露
parameters.name: auth_password

parameters.help_en:
The new SSL setting. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable.
-1: Use the default setting.
If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated. SSL is supported only for ADB_MYSQL, CLICKHOUSE, MARIADB, MYSQL, OCEANBASEX, POLARDB, SELECTDB, and STARROCKS
parameters.help_zh: 新的 SSL 设置：1-启用，0-关闭，-1-使用默认设置；不传表示不更新。仅 ADB_MYSQL、CLICKHOUSE、MARIADB、MYSQL、OCEANBASEX、POLARDB、SELECTDB、STARROCKS 支持 SSL
parameters.name: use_ssl

parameters.help_en: The new Alibaba Cloud RAM role ARN. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 新的阿里云 RAM 角色 ARN；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en: The new name of the KMS managed credential. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 新的 KMS 托管凭据名称；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: kms_secret

parameters.help_en: The environment type. Valid values: product, pre, dev, test, sit, uat, pet, and stag. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 环境类型。取值：product、pre、dev、test、sit、uat、pet、stag；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the cloud instance name as the data source name. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No.
If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用云端实例名称作为数据源名称：1-是，0-否；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: sync_alias

parameters.help_en:
The registration method. Valid values:
INSTANCE_ID: Select an existing cloud instance.
HOST_PORT: Register by endpoint and port.
If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 录入方式：INSTANCE_ID-选择已有云实例，HOST_PORT-按连接地址和端口录入；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: create_mode

parameters.help_en: Optional. The new ID of the data access security policy. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。新的数据访问安全策略 ID；不传表示不更新
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC used to access the data source over a VPC NAT link. This parameter is used to supplement the missing VPC information in the instance details. Optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: VPC NAT 链路访问数据源时使用的专有网络 VPC ID，用于补充实例明细中缺失的 VPC 信息。可选，不传时保留原值
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone used to access the data source over a VPC NAT link. Optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: VPC NAT 链路访问数据源时使用的可用区 ID。可选，不传时保留原值
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch used to access the data source over a VPC NAT link. Optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: VPC NAT 链路访问数据源时使用的虚拟交换机 ID。可选，不传时保留原值
parameters.name: vswitch_id

AdbSparkResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the ADB MySQL Spark resource group. This parameter is returned only for data source details where DbType is ADB_MYSQL_SPARK. It is independent of the schema (database name)
AdbSparkResourceGroup.description_zh: ADB MySQL Spark 资源组名称，仅 DbType=ADB_MYSQL_SPARK 的数据源详情返回；与 Schema（数据库名）独立
AdbSparkResourceGroup.title_en: ADB MySQL Spark 资源组名称，仅 DbType=ADB_MYSQL_SPARK 的数据源详情返回；与 Schema（数据库名）独立。
AdbSparkResourceGroup.title_zh: ADB MySQL Spark 资源组名称，仅 DbType=ADB_MYSQL_SPARK 的数据源详情返回；与 Schema（数据库名）独立。

Alias.description_en: The display name of the data source

AuthAccount.description_en: The logon username for the data source. This parameter is empty if username authentication is not used
AuthAccount.description_zh: 数据源登录用户名；未使用用户名认证时为空

AuthPassword.description_en: The masked value of the password or token. The actual content is not returned
AuthPassword.description_zh: 密码或令牌的脱敏值，不会返回真实内容

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:
-1: no authentication required
0: username and password
1: password only
2: password-free
AuthType.description_zh: 认证方式：-1-无需认证，0-用户名和密码，1-仅密码，2-免密

CatalogName.description_en: The name of the metadata catalog associated with the data source
CatalogName.description_zh: 数据源关联的元数据目录（Catalog）名称

CreateMode.description_en:
The registration method of the data source. Valid values:
INSTANCE_ID: select an existing cloud instance
HOST_PORT: register by endpoint and port
CreateMode.description_zh: 数据源录入方式：INSTANCE_ID-选择已有云实例，HOST_PORT-按连接地址和端口录入

DataSourceUuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the data source

DbType.description_en: The data source type. Valid values: MYSQL, POSTGRESQL, ORACLE, SQLSERVER, MARIADB, POLARDB, POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, POLARDB_ORACLE, OCEANBASEX, DRDS, ADB_MYSQL, ADB_POSTGRESQL, CLICKHOUSE, SELECTDB, STARROCKS, HOLOGRES, MAXCOMPUTE, ES_REST, and TRINO

EnvType.description_en: The environment type. Valid values: product, pre, dev, test, sit, uat, pet, and stag

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the data source was created. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
GmtCreate.description_zh: 数据源创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the data source was last updated. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
GmtModified.description_zh: 数据源最后修改时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Host.description_en: The endpoint of the data source. A masked value may be returned in sensitive scenarios
Host.description_zh: 数据源连接地址；敏感场景可能返回脱敏值

InstanceResourceId.description_en: The ID of the cloud resource instance. This parameter may be empty for data sources registered by endpoint
InstanceResourceId.description_zh: 云资源实例 ID；按连接地址录入的数据源可能为空

InstanceSource.description_en:
The source of the data source. Valid values:
RDS: ApsaraDB instance
PUBLIC_OWN: self-managed database connected over the Internet
ECS_OWN: self-managed database hosted on an ECS instance
GATEWAY: database connected through Database Gateway
VPC_IDC: database connected through a VPC or data center
InstanceSource.description_zh: 数据源来源。取值：RDS-云数据库实例，PUBLIC_OWN-公网自建数据库，ECS_OWN-ECS 自建数据库，GATEWAY-通过数据库网关接入，VPC_IDC-专有网络或 IDC 接入

KmsSecret.description_en: The name of the KMS-managed credential. This parameter is empty if KMS is not used. This is sensitive information
KmsSecret.description_zh: KMS 托管凭据名称；未使用 KMS 时为空，属于敏感信息

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the data access security policy currently in use. This parameter is empty if no policy is set
PolicyId.description_zh: 当前使用的数据访问安全策略 ID；未设置时为空

Port.description_en: The connection port of the data source

RegionId.description_en: The region where the data source is located

ResourceAccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs
ResourceAccountId.description_zh: 资源所属的阿里云主账号 ID

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role used to access the data source. This parameter is empty if role-based authorization is not used
RoleArn.description_zh: 访问数据源使用的阿里云 RAM 角色 ARN；未使用角色授权时为空

Schema.description_en: The name of the connection target. For ADB_POSTGRESQL, DRDS, POSTGRESQL, and POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, this indicates the database name. For ORACLE, this indicates the SID or service name. For POLARDB_ORACLE, this indicates the SID. For MAXCOMPUTE, this indicates the project. For other types, this parameter is usually empty
Schema.description_zh: 连接目标名称。ADB_POSTGRESQL、DRDS、POSTGRESQL、POLARDB_POSTGRESQL 表示数据库名；ORACLE 表示 SID 或服务名；POLARDB_ORACLE 表示 SID；MAXCOMPUTE 表示 Project；其他类型通常为空

State.description_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:
0: normal
-1: deleted
-2: disabled
State.description_zh: 数据源状态：0-正常，-1-已删除，-2-已禁用

SyncAlias.description_en:
Specifies whether to use the cloud instance name as the data source name. Valid values:
1: yes
0: no
SyncAlias.description_zh: 是否使用云端实例名称作为数据源名称：1-是，0-否

UseSsl.description_en:
The SSL settings. Valid values:
1: enable
0: disable
-1: use default settings
UseSsl.description_zh: SSL 设置：1-启用，0-关闭，-1-使用默认设置

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails. This parameter is empty when the call is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误码；成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails. This parameter is empty when the call is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息；成功时为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID used to trace the call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful
